entries.title: Static Branch-Antlered Deer
entries.description: One original complete static stylized antlered deer: a long continuous tapered torso carried by four narrow joint-shaped legs with full flat dark hoof soles, an ascending long neck supporting a small cheeked head and tapered muzzle with integral nose, two outward pointed thick ears, a short tapered tail, and two complete thick branching antlers. Each antler is one continuous closed branched solid with a rising beam and three distinct offshoot tines. Eyes, inner ears, nose and hooves are integral face materials. Thirteen closed editable meshes meet at twelve complete finite planar joints. Four full ground soles, entire finite material domains, antler clefts, leg spaces and all noncontact pairs are tested against the exported geometry. Five opaque matte constant PBR colors. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, ground origin horizontally bounds centred. One prop, zero scenes or variants. Entire animal geometry is newly authored; no rabbit, tortoise, bird or carousel-horse geometry reused. No fur, textures, separate eyes, clothing, pedestal, vegetation, rig, skeleton or animation. Fixed artistic appearance only; no real species identification, anatomical or biological precision, ecology, animal behaviour, locomotion, physical stability, manufacturing, safety or old-asset compatibility claim.

entries.title: Low-Front Picking Bin
entries.description: One original static low-front picking bin with a continuous thick floor and wall shell, a high back, two rising sloped side-wall mouths and a low front retaining wall. The complete deep interior opens upward and through a genuinely low front access mouth. Two separate longitudinal flat skids support the full floor. A small separate thick front label frame has a real empty recessed rectangular aperture backed by the solid front wall; no label or text is included. Four closed connected editable meshes, three constant opaque untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground origin. One bin form and one prop, zero scenes. Newly authored shell and low-front silhouette, not a recolored attached-lid tote, produce crate, bait box, postal cubby, boot tray or cart. No lid, hinge, contents, stacking keys, assembly scene, texture or animation. Static visual geometry only: no capacity, loading, stacking, nesting, hanging, automated picking, transport, material suitability, manufacturing, hygiene, ergonomics, installation, equipment compatibility or safety certification claim.

entries.title: Village Market Crossroads
entries.description: Four-direction village market crossroad with a clear central turning court, two orthogonal complete produce-stall frontages, separate southwest delivery pocket and northeast notice forecourt. Four unit-scale rigid complete original placements of three original IDs on one scene-only support slab. Static finite empty volumes only; no continuous navigation, accessibility, vehicle turning, functional trade, load or safety certification. The intact canopy, counter, trays and produce remain in both stalls. No recolor, deleted part or rescaled original; the external slab edge is 0.06m high and requires site placement.

entries.title: Long Striped Beach Sling Chaise
entries.description: One complete original static beach chaise longue with an extended horizontal leg deck rising continuously into an inclined back. The thick striped sling is one closed connected shared-edge mesh; seven longitudinal ivory and marine-teal bands are true face materials, with no duplicate skins. Two full shaped timber side frames integrate the long rails, raised back rails and four broad flat feet. Two independent transverse low stretchers join both frames. Five editable closed connected meshes and three opaque constant matte untextured PBR materials form one prop, zero scenes. Newly authored geometry, not a renamed or stretched camping chair, observing stool or high rescue seat. Native Z up, front -Y, metre-based game space, centred footprint and full-foot ground datum. One fixed display pose only: no folding, adjustment, joints in motion, cloth simulation, sitting animation, comfort, human suitability, load, stability, weather resistance, manufacture, installation or safety certification. No person, pillow, towel, umbrella, sand, textures, text or exported backdrop.

entries.title: Flared Through-Chock Deck Fitting
entries.description: One original low static harbor fairlead-shaped deck fitting with a continuous thick octagonal horizontal through-eye, a visibly flared entrance at both mouths, a broad chamfer-cornered base and four separate hexagonal seated head details. The elongated opening is real and remains empty through the full depth and beyond both ends. The cast-shaped ring is one closed connected mesh with continuous walls around the entire opening, resting by its whole finite lower face on the base. Six closed editable meshes, three opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, opening axis Y, front -Y and bounds-centred ground origin. One complete prop, zero scenes. Original numeric geometry; no imported models, ropes, chain, vessel, dock, textures, labels, animation or alternate sizes. Fixed visual appearance only: no line-guiding operation, mooring, pull strength, friction, rope or vessel compatibility, anchoring, real installation, load capacity, stability, manufacturing, corrosion resistance or maritime/equipment safety certification.

entries.title: Wavy-Rim Continuous Funnel Fungus
entries.description: One original stylised woodland fungus prop with an integral gently bent stem, broad asymmetric funnel cap, real depressed open upper bowl, thick undulating rim and coherent lighter underside. The cap and grounded stem are one continuous shared-vertex closed editable mesh, not intersecting separate pieces. Five restrained opaque constant untextured matte PBR tones follow whole cap, edge and underside bands. The complete inset material, open funnel air and finite flat sole are geometrically checked. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal envelope-centred ground origin. One whole prop and zero scenes; no old mushroom geometry imported. A structural fungus variation from the original nature expansion plan, distinct from the existing nine convex cap-and-stem mushrooms. Stylised game-art only; no botanical species identification, scientific anatomy, edible/poisonous classification, ecology, growth, harvesting, food use, simulation, animation, collision, navigation or physical stability claim. No log, soil island, other mushrooms or scenery included.

entries.title: Continuous Mineral Vein Rock Wall Module
entries.description: One original static thick faceted cave-wall module with a single continuous irregular mineral vein physically filling the entire rising and falling interface between lower and upper rock bodies. The vein has a genuine outward faceted ridge, varying finite height, and full front-to-back depth; it is not a painted stripe, floating crystal row or overlay. Three closed connected editable meshes form one complete wall, with twelve entire opposed sloped interface patches and one complete flat ground sole. Four constant opaque matte untextured PBR materials. Exact left and right finite end profiles and their material partitions repeat by a 2.4 m X translation with this same module only; positional and material continuity, not tangent smoothness or any old-module compatibility. Native Z up, front -Y, origin at the ground projection of the X midpoint and rear/front reference centre; metres describe game space. One reusable modular model and zero scenes, not three independent models or a material variant. Newly authored whole geometry, no imported rock, mineral specimen, cliff or masonry. No loose ore, crystals, plants, mine equipment or scene. Stylised visual appearance only; no mineral identification, ore composition, geological formation, crystallography, scientific accuracy, excavation, terrain simulation, real structural support, load, stability, manufacturing, installation, collision, navigation or safety claim.
